name: architecture-board
description: Review-ready architecture boards for Claude Code: trust-boundary maps, sequence diagrams, threat flows and decision lists rendered to PDF, PNG and Mermaid.

plugins.name: architecture-board
plugins.description: Generate dense, precise, multi-page architecture boards (component and trust-boundary maps, sequence diagrams with frames and notes, threat/incident flows, data, deployment and operations views, changes or key-decisions lists) as PDF + HTML + per-page PNG + Mermaid. Any page count or size, light/dark/brand themes, Arabic and RTL support.
